content.expected_result: Independent current-record edits merge normally; competing edits to the same file use Git conflicts.
preconditions: Commit two independent current stories in an isolated Git repository, then create branches with independent edits and separate conflicting edits to one current file.

steps.action: Merge independent current-record edits on separate branches.
steps.expected_result: Each stable record retains its identity and authored content without a Saga revision graph.

steps.action: Merge branches that change the same current state or content file.
steps.expected_result: Git exposes the conflict for explicit author resolution; Saga does not invent a head or select a timestamp winner.

steps.action: Resolve the Git conflict deliberately, commit the complete current record, and inspect both branch commits.
steps.expected_result: Both original branch values remain in Git, and the resolved current file is complete and valid.

content.title: Merge independent current records and preserve Git conflicts
